title: Cognition is a relation between system and environment

statements.text: Cognition is not an event happening inside the system but the relational process of sense-making between the system and its environment. What goes on inside the head is only a participant in it, and calling internal processes cognitive confuses levels: neurons do not think and feel, people and animals do. The view is neither internalist nor externalist.

sources.quote: Cognition is not an event happening inside the system; it is the relational process of sense-making that takes place between the system and its environment.
